fields.label: Address for Map Pin

fields.instructions: Search for the address, or place the marker on the map.

fields.label: Display Address
fields.name: address
fields.instructions:
Having difficulties with the Google address finder above? Or maybe want to display the address differently?

This field will show up as the main address in the listing, however it will not affect the map.

sub_fields.label: Available Space (Property Search Filter)
sub_fields.name: available_space_filter
sub_fields.instructions: This field populates the Available Space filter on the Property Search page. This number will likely be a duplicate of dimensions below. This is okay! It won't display on the listing page.

fields.label: Featured Property Details
fields.name: highlighted_property_details
fields.instructions: Please select up to 3 items. These will be displayed beneath the photo on the property listing page.

fields.label: Property Type Photo
fields.name: property_type_photo
fields.instructions: This image will be displayed anywhere the Property Type is featured. The most prominent place would be the home page Featured Property Types section.
